services.desc: Rate Person: $33 About The banana boat holds 12 people max! The booking minimum is 4 people. You board one of our coast guard certified parasail boats and enjoy a ride out to the ocean. Once out there, our mate will assist each person onto the banana and we will pull you behind the boat from 1st street to 31st street and back. services.name: Jet Ski Rental
services.desc: There’s no better feeling than riding across the waves on a jet ski. Rudee Inlet Jet Ski offers a large selection of one, two, and three-person Yamaha WaveRunners for you to take out into the Atlantic Ocean. We have the largest riding area in Virginia Beach. After a tutorial on safely operating the jet skis, head out on the open water for an amazing experience! Rudee Inlet Jet Ski has been family-owned and operated since 1985. Our adventures are safe and fun for the whole family. We’re conveniently located two blocks off the resort strip on Rudee Inlet, next to Big Sam’s Restaurant and Raw Bar. Don’t forget we offer free parking at Big Sam’s. Take to the skies and parasail over Virginia
